notes: The circuit image was not available; wiring follows the text of the 'Circuit' section. Breadboard hole positions are assumed.

Pot circuit: white wire 5V -> one outer pot leg, orange wire GND -> other outer leg, gray wire from wiper to A0. The text says A0 reads voltage 'from pin13', but the wiring description (5V to the pot) is used instead.
LED circuit: red wire from pin 11 -> resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> green wire -> GND.
Resistor value is not given; 220 ohm assumed.
The usb-cable catalogue part has no ports, so USB edges have null ports on the cable. A laptop part type was added for the computer. The UNO USB-B socket is not a named catalogue port.
Software (MATLAB, support package) is not a physical part. The built-in LED on D13 is part of the UNO.
The second GND header (GND.2) is assumed for the green wire; GND.1 for the orange wire.
